content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Associate-III Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of Research Associate-III at All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate-III position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates do not need to apply online.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 18 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-III post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree, or MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech/M.Sc with at least 3 years of research experience and one research paper in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI) Journal.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate-III post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve an Interview. A screening test may be conducted if there is a large number of candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur, Rajasthan.
